description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with durable Player17 saves and native research, fleet navigation, shipyard and construction workspaces. Costs, requirements, timed orders and cancellation refunds use canonical simulation rules and sovereign currencies. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Ordinary unlock progression, full production visuals, colony/system/diplomacy screens and audio remain under development. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
